aoi_crop.how: This full file (421,431,498 bytes) exceeds this Cowork session's per-file device-staging cap (~400 MiB) and was never brought into the cloud workspace whole. device_bash, which would normally crop it in place on the project owner's machine, was blocked for the whole project by a tracked Windows-mount issue. The project owner ran scripts/crop_enmap_scene.py locally instead (same AOI-bbox + 150 m buffer window used for the 2022-09-08 scene) and the resulting 264,247-byte, 224-band crop was staged normally. See data/water_mask/provenance_20240424.json and docs/WATER_MASK.md sections 8-9 for what was derived from it.
